callees.name: _function_spans
callees.pre_condition: filepath is a path to an existing readable source file. lang_key is a recognized language key string. proj_dir, when provided, is a directory path for project-context function detection.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple (spans, raw_lines) where spans is a list of (name, start_line, end_line) tuples identifying every top-level function in the file by name and its 0-indexed inclusive line range, ordered by ascending start line, and raw_lines is a list of strings containing the file's original lines, one per element.
